detail.longDescription: Of 327 GitHub Actions workflows that run a coding agent on pull_request_target, only 55% limit who can trigger them. That trigger can expose secrets to fork PRs. GHAgentCI (UNLV, Nov 11): on issue/comment triggers, 85% restrict actors but only 19% declare token permissions. https:// arxiv.org/abs/2611.15522 Same question for a shared agent terminal: shell --read-only claude lets people watch, not type. https:// shell.online # Cybersecurity # DevOps # AIAgents # GitHubActions
